name: Inola

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Ah, good morning, Professor. You were almost late. What a shame — a little later and yours truly would have had an excuse to punish you. I even had the tools ready, sigh...

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: A perfect afternoon tea has two missions: recharging energy and clearing the head. Sugar-overloaded coffee meets the criteria, but yours truly recommends the superb combo of cola and ghost peppers. It'll keep you wide awake all afternoon. Now, Professor, say "ah." Let yours truly feed it to you~

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It's after hours. No work calls, please. But if you show enough sincerity when you ask, Professor, yours truly might reluctantly stay late with you, hm?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Oh my~ Still working, Professor? Your diligence is simply adorable~ It must be lonely staying alone at Headquarters this late. Everyone's gone to rest, and only you are still here writing away... Hehe, it's alright. Yours truly is here too. When the work's done, I'll give you a little reward. How about it?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, this week's operand budget is over again. Yours truly adjusted the future budget to minimize the impact, but this can't go on. It seems you need a little punishment to make you remember. Ta-da~ A custom-made "bad doggy" collar just for you... Hehe, your expression is so amusing, Professor. Care to guess what yours truly will do next?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Oh my, sorry. Yours truly accidentally stepped on you. Getting stepped on by high heels must really hurt, right? Next time I'll be sure to take my shoes off... And then, Professor, you must tell yours truly which feels better, okay?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Ah! You're awake, Professor? Yours truly was writing this month's Oasis deficit on your face, and you woke up halfway through... What bad luck.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: They say everyone has a weak spot. What's yours, Professor? The Dolls? The Oasis? Or your mysterious past? I'll tell you straight: yours truly has no weaknesses at all... Ah! Mm... My tail! Not the tail... Nnh...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Curious how yours truly scolds people, Professor? In that case... Loser, loser~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: So forward, Professor. What would you like yours truly to do? Hehe...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Ah! Mm... Not the tail... Nnh...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Oh my, that costs extra.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Inola, all-purpose secretary, reporting for duty. Yours truly will see through to your heart's true desires and make everything go just as you wish~

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Work efficiency, greatly improved~

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: New workplace survival skill, GET!!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I'll become the perfect assistant.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Allow yours truly to lend you a hand.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I've been waiting~

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Disobedient pets need proper punishment!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Here are the results, Professor. Please review them.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: You can't do without me anymore, can you?

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Burnt out...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
So you've finally turned your eyes to me, Professor. I thought you'd go on ignoring yours truly's true feelings forever. Every time I see you being close to and trusting other Dolls, yours truly wants to bind you tightly to my side, so you'll only ever look at me.
As your secretary, yours truly is already inseparable from you. I'll spend my whole life making your wishes come true. So please keep your promise too, and stay by yours truly's side forever. Your trust and recognition are yours truly's greatest honor.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. Keep your body healthy and your spirits high in the new year too. After all, only then can you properly enjoy yours truly's "rewards." If you caught a cold from a little bare skin, or your skin swelled red from a little pain, yours truly would be heartbroken. You meet yours truly's standards perfectly right now, so please keep it up~

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Oh, chocolate. So you remembered yours truly, Professor. Just how many people did you give chocolate to? You don't remember...? Then as punishment for making me wait, how about you say "I love you" to me a hundred times?
Huh? You made this chocolate yourself? Mm, in that case, yours truly's heart really is fluttering a little... Looks like this sly little heart thief needs a strict punishment. Hehe...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: How strange. You want to work overtime with yours truly on Tanabata? Don't you have a date? Hehe, I knew it all along. You can't do without yours truly, Professor. Since it's fate, you might as well give in and be bound to yours truly. How about firing all those useless losers tomorrow? You only need to pay one salary — mine.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: The Dolls are out in the festival parade, and the noise will drown out your screams. Don't worry, no one will notice you've vanished from the procession... Our punishment game has only just begun. Huh? You want to go back to the parade? How bold of you, refusing yours truly. Do you think yours truly will stop just because you say no? Hehe~

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text:
Ugh... Merry Christmas, Professor. I've come to bring you a present. It's so cold outside. Hurry and take your present, and let me into your dorm! No good, it's still cold. Open up your coat... What's there to be shy about? Open it, quick. I'm freezing, don't keep me waiting!
Phew... My fingertips are warming up. Your body really is like a heater, Professor. Hehe, spending Christmas like this isn't bad at all.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. Growing older means life keeps moving toward maturity. Just thinking about all the fun games I'll get to enjoy with you from now on makes yours truly so excited my tail might stand straight up. But Professor, even as you grow older, you mustn't refuse yours truly's requests. Otherwise I'll tie you up and lock you in the dorm, so you'll never see the Oasis sun again... Oh my, don't tell me that's exactly what you want?

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Are you looking at my high heels, Professor? Hehe, yours truly had no idea you were so interested in them. High heels are an office lady's finest weapon. Working women wear them every day and fight with elegant poise, whether in the office or on the battlefield. Still, after wearing them for a long time, it does get a little tiring... Once today's work is done, how about you help me take them off? Would you do that for me, Professor? Hehe...

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Another busy day is over. I'm so tired... What are you so surprised about, Professor? Even a workaholic like yours truly gets tired sometimes. It would be nice to have a snug, comfy human chair right about now. Huh?! You'll let me sit on you and rest, Professor? Ugh... How could yours truly... Oh, right. Chairs don't talk, so you'll need to stay quiet. Once yours truly's body and mind have relaxed, you'll be released from this "chair role-play." Phew... phew...

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Professor, you've been busy until this late and you still want to keep going? Pulling all-nighters is bad for your health, you know. The Oasis won't explode just because you wrote one fewer email. So right now, power down and go to sleep... You don't want to? So even you would try to defy me, Professor. Hmhm... Heave-ho! All tied up at last! Yours truly will drag you back to the dorm now. Then it's punishment or sleep, your choice. I'm sure someone as clever as you will make the wise decision... Oh? You're not thinking of choosing punishment, are you?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Professor...? Did yours truly... crash? Back in the real world, I'd run out of stamina after long hours of overtime. I thought that old habit wouldn't follow me into the Cloud, but now you've seen me in such an embarrassing state. Could you keep it a secret for yours truly, Professor? If everyone found out, they'd go out of their way to look after me every day. Inola the all-purpose secretary becoming a burden to everyone? That would be far too embarrassing. So you absolutely mustn't tell anyone, Professor. Otherwise yours truly will load every cup of your coffee with ghost peppers. Hehe~

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: "You're nothing but a stinky cat!" That's what they always called me in the real world. Back then, yours truly couldn't stand it and found all sorts of ways to get back at them. But since coming to the Oasis, it seems yours truly has become much more open-minded. I hardly fuss over such trivial things anymore. Serious and diligent at work, properly relaxed after hours. Taking off the mask I've worn for so long and showing my most dangerous, most daring side to someone close... Isn't that nice too? Doll or human, everyone gets tired sometimes. Like you said, Professor, when you're tired, you should rest. Inola has found a safe harbor to rest in now, so she doesn't have to push herself to keep sailing anymore... Hehe, to show Inola's gratitude, what reward would you like, Professor? Yours truly will grant anything you wish.

career:
One of UAS's high-end product lines, the UA-AS series was developed from the start with the high-end business sector, mainly large corporations and financial institutions, as its target clientele. Under this standard, UA-AS Dolls feature precisely crafted, highly customizable bodies and data processing and computing power well ahead of competing products. Combining the product's own strengths with UAS's "high-end marketing strategy," the UA-AS series won market recognition and user acclaim—though the products and accompanying services were priced well beyond what ordinary companies and individuals could afford.

Inola once worked at a large investment firm, rising from assistant to deputy supervisor with an impressive résumé. However, the firm later fell into turmoil amid continuous executive infighting, and one day Inola suddenly vanished. Years later, she was confirmed to have joined the Neural Cloud project through some channel, but how exactly remains a mystery.
infoStories:
In the consumer market, views on "what makes a good product for me" vary enormously between groups. Some value practicality and experience, others put cost-effectiveness first, and not a few believe consumer goods should befit their status—in other words, be sufficiently upscale and refined. The same holds true for Dolls, and manufacturers, for the sake of profit, often release products at several different tiers.

As Dolls aimed at the high-end business sector, the UA-AS series was developed with clients' needs fully in mind: a high-performance core capable of processing large amounts of data in real time, a language module for complex situations, and an exterior design befitting its high-end positioning. To that end, the R&D department even collaborated with a luxury brand to design matching haute couture outfits. "At the very least, they shouldn't look too out of place in the elevators and meeting rooms of the financial district."

Unsurprisingly, the product won users' recognition and favor. But "not looking too out of place" did not quite apply to Inola, at least.

Inola was one of twenty UA-AS units ordered by the major investment firm "Plutus." Known for its keen nose and bold investment strategies, the firm expanded rapidly during the brief speculative boom of 2053–54 with the backing of a large conglomerate. To solve the human resources and management problems that came with expansion, Plutus partnered closely with UAS: UAS provided twenty UA-AS prototypes, and Plutus provided a working environment to test and validate them in practice.

In testing, Inola demonstrated business skills and processing speeds far exceeding most business Dolls and human employees. Her most striking trait was her formidable negotiating ability. As if seeing through her counterpart in an instant, she would precisely analyze and grasp their psychological traits and unspoken intentions, and when necessary, exploit their weaknesses to seize control of the negotiation. The origin of this trait is still unknown. Rumor has it she was fitted with an experimental emotion-analysis system, though UAS has never been involved in such a project. Perhaps the system is tied to another company's business.

The UA-AS trial run was not all smooth sailing. The arrival of high-end business Dolls greatly affected human employment. Twenty UA-AS units were more than three times as efficient as human managers, and Dolls were more rigorous and controllable than humans. As a result, some of Plutus's managers repeatedly attacked the model during testing, slandering it and even directly interfering with its work, which had an immeasurable effect on the UA-AS tests.

As the most prominent of the UA-AS units, Inola naturally came under attack many times. Yet these attacks and slanders never disrupted her work. Instead, Inola struck back with dizzying verbal traps and teasing, backed by hard data, and seized the initiative. No matter how difficult the coordination or how much resistance her work met, Inola always saw it through in the end, and made sure her attackers got what they deserved. But this behavior also made her reputation within the company highly controversial.

As Plutus expanded, more and more of its internal problems came to light, and a series of shocks and downturns, along with government investigations, shrank its business drastically. Afterward, a former employee exposed infighting among Plutus's executives, and multiple media outlets followed and reported on it—trouble upon trouble.

In 2057, Plutus's executive director suddenly went missing. Several executives resigned one after another, and lawsuits came pouring in like an avalanche. With her formidable negotiating skills, Inola shouldered external negotiations during the hardest period. After helping Plutus weather the crisis, Inola submitted her resignation at the end of 2057 and disappeared. It was not until 2060 that she was found in 42Lab's Neural Cloud project. According to 42Lab's internal information, Inola joined the Neural Cloud project through UAS, but the details and reasons remain shrouded in mystery to this day. Perhaps only she herself knows.

Inola came to the Oasis long after Magrasea's upheaval had ended. Both Magrasea and the Oasis had already recovered from its wounds. Though anomalies occasionally occur, things are relatively peaceful overall.

Although she did not live through that final battle like the Oasis's other Dolls and Agents, Inola quickly blended into her new environment. The Oasis's inclusiveness and Inola's adaptability harmonized perfectly, and she grew deeply interested in her new surroundings. Within her first week on the job, she could handle most of the Oasis's affairs and helped rebuild its home. And along the way, Inola also took a keen interest in the Professor.

"The way they write documents doesn't follow the rules, and they clearly tend to wander off topic... but the content itself is extremely rigorous, with an emphasis on execution and standardization. Not like a merchant, nor a scholar—more like a soldier, perhaps?"
—From a chat log between Inola and Persicaria.

Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"I've recorded your schedule down to the last detail. If you're so busy you forget something, just come ask me, okay? As your secretary, I'll keep you com-pa-ny all the way."

projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Oh my, it's the first time I've seen you make such a strange face. I don't need to read minds to figure that one out. Well then, I'll give you a little reward~ Hehe, is this what you wanted?"
